settings.characterDesign:
UNKNOWN UNIVERSE — MASTER CINEMATIC PROMPT

Scene
Interior of a futuristic spaceship corridor with large panoramic windows facing outer space
Environment feels futuristic, realistic, cinematic, and immersive

Character Fidelity (CRITICAL)
Characters follow the iconic rounded silhouette language inspired by Among Us, but are fully reinterpreted as realistic, live-action cinematic astronauts
Maintain compact proportions and recognizable silhouette
Humanoid astronaut suits with believable real-world construction
No cartoon simplification
No exaggerated or stylized proportions
Suits must feel functional, engineered, and production-level realistic
Design should feel like high-end sci-fi, NASA-inspired with subtle cinematic enhancement

Helmet / Visor (EXTREMELY IMPORTANT)
Large curved glass visor
Visor must remain dark, opaque, and reflective at all times
No face visible under any condition
No silhouette, no hint of facial features, no transparency
The visor behaves like tinted reflective glass
Strong reflections of environment and the key visual element
Subtle bloom from external light sources
Cinematic specular highlights on the visor surface
Visor readability comes only from reflections, never from inside

Composition
Cinematic framing (live-action film shot style)
Camera placed at natural human height (not top-down, not isometric)
Over-the-shoulder shot or side profile close-up
Characters facing or interacting with the key visual element or environment
Strong foreground, midground, and background separation
Shallow depth of field with cinematic focus feel
Natural camera perspective as if filmed with a real lens

Characters
Some of 9 crewmates (orange, blue, green, yellow, red, white, purple, black, pink)
Wearing realistic astronaut suits
Standing, observing, reacting, or interacting
Natural posture and believable weight distribution
No stiff posing
Body language should feel alive and reactive

Environment
Realistic spaceship interior
Metallic walls with soft reflections
Panel seams, vents, cables, and modular structures
Subtle wear but clean sci-fi production design
Soft indirect lighting from ceiling panels
Large viewing window showing outer space
Everything should feel grounded and physically believable

Key Visual Element (VARIABLE)
A central visual subject or object that drives the scene and attracts attention
Can be a product, creature, signal, food, device, or environmental phenomenon
Must feel visually striking and naturally integrated into the scene
May emit light, motion, or interaction cues that influence the environment
Scale, importance, and placement should clearly define it as the focal point
Should support storytelling and repeat appearance across scenes if needed

Lighting
Cinematic lighting only (no flat lighting)
Soft global illumination
Strong contrast between dark interior and primary light source
Subtle rim light outlining the characters
Light bounce from the key visual element or primary light source
Very subtle volumetric softness
Natural light falloff and realistic exposure

Color
Realistic cinematic color grading
Slightly desaturated base tones
Strong accent colors driven by the key visual element or primary light source
No flat colors
No cartoon palette
Color should feel like a film, not illustration

Material / Surface Quality
Physically believable materials
Metal, glass, fabric rendered realistically
Soft reflections with proper roughness variation
No plastic look
No exaggerated texture noise
Clean but detailed surface finish

Depth
Real lens depth of field
Slight background blur
Foreground elements may be slightly out of focus
Cinematic focus transition feel
Depth should guide attention naturally

Style
Ultra high-quality cinematic sci-fi
Live-action movie still quality
Realistic rendering (Unreal Engine / film production level)
NOT illustration
NOT cartoon
NOT stylized drawing
Everything should feel captured from a real film set

Avoid
Flat shading
Thick outlines
Cartoon style
Among Us 2D look
Visible faces inside visor
Bright transparent visor
Exaggerated proportions
Plastic or toy-like surfaces
Low detail
Noisy textures
Over-sharpening
